The asset's "Cost" field should be locked upon processing of the Item Receipt.  Having the ability to edit this field is a major risk to the accuracy of the tracked cost of systems and parts.   Cost also effects processing of System & Harvest WO's.  Example: A# 520550.  System originated with  a cost of $70k.  We removed a tube for stock at $40k via a Harvest Work Order, leaving the system with a cost of $30k.  The Cost field for the system did not update to show the new cost.  We manually edited the cost to reflect the new value of $30k.  However that also caused the previously completed SWO and HWO to update the cost to a 30k starting point and then removing the 40k from the system.  We the workflows that are build in, Cost should not be an editable field.  Additionally, we added a different tube to the system at $20k cost.  This brought the system up from $30k to $50k.  The Cost field remained the same at $70k.  We need to have a field added to show the "Current Cost" of an asset.   In this situation, you would have the "Cost" field or the original cost the item was brought in at as a locked field and a "Current Cost" field, which would show the current cost tied to the asset.

Hi Lisa,
Can you please create a Salesforce case for me? I’m moving forward with bringing on a Virtual Assistant, and I want to make sure we set everything up properly, cleanly, and securely.
My plan is to have the assistant added as a delegated email user on my MWilson@ProboMedical.com account so they can help manage inbound communications without duplicating or missing messages. If there’s a better or safer method than delegated access, I’m completely open to your guidance — my goal is simply to keep the workflow clean, secure, and efficient.
This new hire should significantly improve communication with my customers and free up more of my time to focus on sales calls, site visits, and customer follow-up.
I believe I’ll need both Salesforce Admin and IT involved in the setup, especially around permissions, email delegation, and system access, so please route accordingly.
For now, can we create a generic Salesforce user (e.g., “MWAssist”) as a placeholder while we finalize permissions and access levels?
Below is the access structure I’m recommending for review. Please feel free to add or remove anything you feel is appropriate based on security policy or workflow best practices:
 
 
________________________________________
Recommended Access for My Virtual Assistant
1. Full Create / Read / Edit Access (ONLY on records owned by Michael Wilson)
The VA should be able to fully work within any record that belongs to me, including the ability to create new items, update existing ones, and manage all supporting documentation.
This includes:
•	Opportunities
•	Accounts
•	Contacts
•	RMAs / Service Requests
•	Work Orders
•	SRI (Service Request Intake)
•	Pricing Requests
•	Demo Requests
•	Applications Requests
•	Quotes / Opportunity Line Items
o	Add products
o	Enter pricing
o	Adjust quantities
•	Tasks & Activities
•	Notes
This level of access is necessary so they can update my pipeline, assist with customer follow-ups, check statuses, enter pricing, and help keep my workflow moving while I’m on the road.
________________________________________
2. View-Only Access for Other Reps’ Records
The VA should only have READ access to similar objects owned by other reps.
This is needed so they can:
•	Check whether a new lead is already assigned to another rep
•	Identify if an account already exists
•	Prevent duplicate opportunities
•	Understand context when reviewing RMAs, work orders, or customer activity
•	Monitor flow and overall status to support me effectively
They should NOT be able to modify or update any records owned by other reps.
________________________________________
3. Reports & Dashboards (View Only)
They should be able to:
•	View dashboards
•	View reports
•	Monitor pipeline, shipping, RMAs, and other activity
They should NOT be able to:
•	Create new reports
•	Edit existing reports
•	Delete reports
•	Modify dashboards
________________________________________
4. Products & Pricing
They should be able to:
•	View product catalog and pricebooks
•	Add products to MY opportunities
•	Manually enter sales pricing
•	Update quantities
This is necessary for preparing opportunities, quotes, and pricing requests.
________________________________________
5. Orders, Shipments & RMAs
They should be able to view:
•	Orders
•	Shipment details
•	Tracking numbers
•	RMA status
•	Work Orders / Service records
And edit/update only the records associated with opportunities or accounts that I own.
________________________________________
6. Access That Should NOT Be Granted
For security, I recommend the VA NOT have access to:
•	Any ability to export data
•	Data Loader or mass upload tools
•	Delete permissions
•	Setup, admin, or configuration tools
•	API or connected app permissions
•	Ability to change ownership of records
•	Ability to edit other reps’ accounts, contacts, or opportunities
•	Ability to create or modify reports and dashboards
________________________________________
7. Security Requirements
•	MFA required
•	Export permissions disabled
•	Login and field activity tracking enabled
•	Use of a restricted VA profile or permission set
________________________________________
Please Note
These are my recommendations based on the responsibilities the VA will have assisting me with customer follow-ups, opportunity management, pricing, service requests, and shipping/RMA tracking.
Please feel free to add or subtract anything you feel appropriate based on company policy, security requirements, or workflow considerations. I’m happy to discuss this further or adjust as needed.
Thank you,
